div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Rice disease classification dataset
10,407 original labelled RGB photos
Collected near Tirunelveli, Tamil Nadu
No guarantee of broad regional generalization

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Duplicate filtering before split
8,419 selected representative images
Prevent duplicate leakage between partitions

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Locked partitions
5,905 train; 1,257 validation; 1,257 test

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Training augmentation only
Random crop, horizontal flip
Rotation around +/-10 degrees and mild colour jitter
ImageNet channel normalization

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
EfficientNet-B0
Initialize backbone with ImageNet weights
Replace classifier with Linear 1280 to 10

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Training
Head training, then fine-tune final two backbone blocks
AdamW + weighted cross-entropy
Checkpoint by validation loss
Architecture comparison by validation macro-F1

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Frozen selected EfficientNet-B0
Test accuracy 85.0438 percent
Test macro-F1 83.5883 percent
Held-out 1,257 photos
Weakest recall: leaf blight 67.21 percent

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
ONNX deployment
Local CPU execution, no photo upload
Expose intermediate outputs without changing weights
Original photo reference logits preserved exactly

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
User uploads rice photograph
JPEG, PNG or WebP
Photo-only flow needs no district

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Safe decode and dimensions
Maximum 10 MB file
At least 128 x 128 pixels
At most 24 megapixels
Reject unsupported or undecodable files

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
EXIF orientation correction
Convert to RGB
Input W x H x 3

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Input-quality checks on 224px grey view
Reject near-constant / very low-detail photo
Warn about blur using Laplacian variance
Warn about extreme mean brightness

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Reject invalid image
Show actionable input error
Do not fabricate a class or score

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Bicubic resize, preserve aspect ratio
Shorter image edge becomes 256 pixels
Longer edge scales proportionately

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Centre crop
RGB image 224 x 224 x 3
Actual cropped image visible in Architecture

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Float pixels
pixel_float = pixel_uint8 / 255
Values initially between 0 and 1

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
ImageNet normalization, channel by channel
R: (R - 0.485) / 0.229
G: (G - 0.456) / 0.224
B: (B - 0.406) / 0.225
Normalized values can be negative

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Transpose HWC to CHW, add batch
Float32 tensor [1,3,224,224]
Only image pixels enter classifier

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Stem Conv2d, normalization, SiLU
Input [1,3,224,224]
Output [1,32,112,112]

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
MBConv stage group 1
Input [1,32,112,112]
Output [1,16,112,112]

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

Output [1,24,56,56]

span.p:
MBConv stage group 3

Output [1,40,28,28]

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

MBConv stage group 5

MBConv stage group 6

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

MBConv stage group 7

Output [1,320,7,7]

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
1x1 convolution feature head
Input [1,320,7,7]
Output [1,1280,7,7]

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Global average pooling
Average each channel over 7x7 spatial positions
Input [1,1280,7,7]
Output [1,1280,1,1]

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Flatten
Output feature vector [1,1280]
1,280 learned visual features

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Classifier dropout
Disabled in evaluation / app inference
Same 1,280 inputs passed to linear classifier

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Learned linear classifier
10 weight rows and 10 biases
logit_i = sum_j W_ij * pooled_j + bias_i
Output [1,10] logits

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
1x1 channel expansion where applicable
Batch normalization and SiLU

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Depthwise spatial convolution
Per-channel neighbourhood filtering
Stride controls spatial downsampling

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Squeeze-and-excitation
Pool channel responses
Learn channel gating factors

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
1x1 projection + batch normalization
Reduce to block output channel count

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Residual connection when shapes/stride permit
Add input to transformed branch
Training regularization disabled during inference

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Stable softmax
u_i = logit_i - max(logits)
p_i = exp(u_i) / sum_j exp(u_j)
Ten nonnegative scores, sum approximately 1

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Fixed class order, indices 0-9
0 bacterial leaf blight
1 bacterial leaf streak
2 bacterial panicle blight
3 blast; 4 brown spot; 5 dead heart
6 downy mildew; 7 hispa
8 normal; 9 tungro

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Candidate = class at argmax(score)
Score is not disease severity
No temperature, district or yield influence

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Highest score below 0.65
OR image quality warning?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Uncertain screening result
Still show highest-scoring candidate and all scores
Ask for a clearer photo / expert confirmation

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Candidate disease / pest-symptom / normal label
Ten proportional class-score bars
Not a confirmed agricultural diagnosis

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Unsupported crops or diseases may receive high scores
Threshold is heuristic, not calibrated confidence
Normal result does not prove absence of disease
No lesion segmentation, severity or yield-loss estimate

Pooling; classifier; softmax/result

Channel min/max and sample activation values

Pooling and classifier inspection
All 1,280 pooled feature values
Ten actual logits

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Feature-map previews are activations
They are not lesion masks, Grad-CAM,
causal evidence or calibrated disease localization

Optional linked yield context
